headline: British hacker sentenced over Scattered Spider crypto theft scheme
summary: A British hacker tied to the Scattered Spider group, identified as Tyler Buchanan of Dundee, was sentenced to six years in a US prison for stealing millions in crypto and hacking roughly a dozen companies. TechCrunch instead describes two British hackers facing prison over a Grand Theft Auto game-maker breach and crypto thefts, a different case status and scope.
